label: live
test: step corrections survive reload and undo launches the requested redo with visible history
expected: the Jevellan web app "undo retry" screen at desktop-dark, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "step corrections survive reload and undo launches the requested redo with visible history"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The error text repeats 'disabled' eight times ('No model can run this step right now: disabled, disabled, …'). It's readable but gives no useful detail, and the same message shows twice: in the red banner and in the Resume correction card.
Some secondary text is dim on the dark background and hard to read: 'Local time', '1 tool', 'Step details', and the grey 'Undone' label in the step header.

Sidebar conversation titles and subtitles are cut off with ellipses (e.g. 'Change the value to thre…', 'Blocked · Browser fixture · dev-…'). This is intentional truncation, and the full title appears in the main header.
The struck-through 'Step 1 · Implement' label is low-contrast. The strikethrough is intended to show the step was undone.
